senses.definition: (publishing) A written work edited and published, as by a certain editor or in a certain manner, or at a certain time.
examples: She wanted a copy of the Clericotes edition, but had to settle for the 1921 edition. She had never liked abridged editions.

senses.definition: The whole number of copies of a work printed and published at one time.
examples: The first edition was soon sold.

senses.definition: An instance of the first or second sense.
examples: What he had found was a particularly valuable first edition.

senses.definition: (sports) A particular instance of an event.
examples: The 2014 edition of the Tour de France started in Leeds, Yorkshire.
